$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the paper library. To publish a new paper: (1) write papers/<id>.md, (2) add an object to the 'papers' array below, (3) run python3 build.py. The website reads this file at runtime — no HTML editing needed.

papers.title: Innovation Earth Projects: A Case Study of a Student-Run, Privacy-First Software Studio Serving Secondary-School Learners
papers.summary: An exploratory qualitative case study of IEP's founding narrative, four shipping rules, and zero-friction design values — and what they suggest about learner-originated tooling in an era of ed-tech dark patterns.

papers.title: Zero Friction Learning: Why Signup Walls Reduce Tool Adoption Among Teenage Students
papers.summary: A short working paper reviewing classroom observations and HCI literature on account-gating, email capture, and onboarding flows as barriers to educational tool adoption for ages 14-18.
